_comment: Chapter 4 of the story revamp (docs/gameplay/23 §4): F16, a rescue: the dwarf the Collectors made dig goes home (the village: a DEF gem).

text.zh_TW: 一個矮人被鍊在牆邊，還在用十字鎬敲石頭。「收集者要我往下挖，挖到『沉睡的東西』為止。我挖到了……然後我就不想再挖了。」
text.en: A dwarf chained to the wall is still swinging his pick at the rock. "The Collectors made me dig down until I hit 'the sleeping things'. I hit them... and then I didn't want to dig any more."

label.zh_TW: （砸開鍊子）「回村裡吧，那裡的石頭比較乖。」
label.en: (Break the chain) "Come to the village. The rocks there behave."

text.zh_TW: 矮人：「哈！好小子。小心點——底下的東西在睡覺，但睡得不沉。」
text.en: Dwarf: "Ha! Good lad. Careful down there. The things below are sleeping, but not deeply."
